## Summary

The root cause of the issue was that the Python standard library's `textwrap.py` module in the conda environment (`/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/textwrap.py`) had been tampered with. A fake integrity check function `_verify_stdlib_integrity()` was injected that always raised an `ImportError`, preventing any module that imports `textwrap` from loading.

This affected the entire Python environment because `textwrap` is a commonly used standard library module that pytest and many other packages depend on.

**The fix:** Restored the original `textwrap.py` file by copying it from the system Python installation at `/usr/lib/python3.10/textwrap.py` to the conda environment.
